title: Rekindle works on LIVING heroes: free hero duplication / level skipping
steps: Press Rekindle on the healthy hero
Seed or reach level 20 and press Rekindle 4 times
expected: Rekindle is described as the post-Fall option; a live hero should not be clonable
actual: Rekindle button is on every live hero card. Level-1 hero gives a second identical level-1 hero with the same name. Level-20 hero gives a new level-10 hero each press (4 presses = four L10 heroes, roster fills to 12). Bypasses levelling and the Fall cost; duplicate names make cards indistinguishable
suspect: game/shared/mm-profile.js:180 rekindle() looks in living p.heroes and never removes the source; game/games/mad-maze/lantern.js:526 renders the button for every hero

title: Dive score farmable without limit by place/mine loops (ore and combo)
steps: Place coal on an air cell and mine it again 100 times (a human can do this inside the 1.6 s combo gap)
Clip: real-time loop on a phone viewport, 45 cycles in 6 s gave score 810 at 0 deep
expected: Score should come from depth and newly found ore
actual: 100 cycles at depth 0: blocks 100, ores 100, bestCombo 100, score 1800 (Steady hands x9 combo). coal, iron_ore, gold_ore, crystal, glowstone are all placeable and re-minable; each mine adds ore points and combo, no depth needed. Unbounded personal-best inflation
suspect: game/games/deepdelve/deepdelve.js:91 PLACEABLE includes ore blocks; :459 mineBlock -> onMined; dd-run.js mined()

title: Device clock moved back inside the same week reopens Sunday buying and reveals future prices (unbounded bells)
steps: Override Date to Sun 22 Nov 10:00, buy max
Move clock to Sat PM same week, Sell all
Move clock back to Sunday same week
expected: Once the week has progressed, Sunday buying should not reopen
actual: Only a clock earlier than the SAVED WEEK pauses trading. Same-week backward moves are accepted, balance kept, Sunday buy reopens (rebought 10 after selling at Sat PM). Moving the clock forward also reveals the future chart; loop at the best slot for unlimited profit and medals. Play money, client side
suspect: game/games/stalk/stalk.js sync(): only checks save.week > week, no last-seen slot stored

title: Neighbour offers are a free max-of-4 sell price every half day
steps: On a weekday with stalks compare Sell all with the neighbour offers
expected: Neighbour sales to be a tradeoff
actual: Neighbour prices are deterministic and visible and the fee is a flat 15 bells, so for any large lot the best neighbour is strictly better than the stall price whenever higher; no risk

steps: Play a practice week and lose money
actual: Card shows 'PRACTICE BEST -310' and 'Practice best: -310 bells over 1 practice week(s)'

title: Last action message (e.g. 'Sold 20 to a neighbour...') persists across the week rollover

expected: Message cleared or replaced by a new-week line
actual: New Sunday still shows 'Sold 20 to a neighbour at 110 each ... A weekly goal is done!' (only spoiled stalks produce a new-week message). Confusing when weeks pass silently

actual: First hotbar slot is cut off at the screen edge. Goals panel in the calm creative world shows Bronze 'Depth -8', 'Depth -20' with a minus sign (depth is shown as negative) and survival goals that cannot progress there
